item.title: Mercedes unveil 2026 S-Class facelift; brings it with a new V8 engine
item.description: Mercedes have given their long-standing S-Class a mid-lifecycle upgrade along with interior and exterior upgrades that are both subtle but quite noticeable.

item.title: Was Ajit Pawar mulling NCP factions’ merger? Close aide say announcement was likely in February
item.description: Ajit Pawar in July 2024, parted ways with the Sharad Pawar-led NCP and joined the BJP-led Mahayuti government in Maharashtra along with eight MLAs, resulting in a split in the NCP.

item.title: 35-something men affected by erectile dysfunction; do you know the reason?
item.description: Erectile dysfunction is the persistent inability to achieve or maintain an erection firm enough for sexual intercourse. ED can happen occasionally, but frequent or ongoing difficulty signals a medical issue that needs evaluation.

item.title: Kerala Budget 2026: Free education extended to graduation level, first in India
item.description: Kerala has announced free education up to the graduate level, becoming the first state in India to do so. The Kerala Budget 2026 proposed to makes undergraduate arts and science courses free in government and aided colleges. Earlier the state’s free education policy was only till Class 12.

item.title: Google Project Genie launch brings Genie 3 powered AI 3D world creation tool
item.description: Google has introduced Project Genie, an experimental tool that allows users to create and explore AI generated 3D worlds. The prototype is powered by Genie 3 and is rolling out first to Google AI Ultra subscribers in the U.S.

item.title: Sabarimala gold theft: SIT grills Jayaram, eyes him as key witness
item.description: In a stunning twist to the Sabarimala gold theft case, SIT questioned actor Jayaram at his Chennai home, eyeing him as a witness. He revealed a 40-year temple link with accused Potty, who suggested home pujas with sacred gold plates for prosperity. As Potty nears bail, Jayaram’s testimony could expose the scam.

item.title: SpaceX in merger talks with xAI and Tesla ahead of $1 trillion IPO, Elon Musk’s biggest move yet
item.description: SpaceX is in talks to merge with Elon Musk’s AI startup xAI and is also exploring a potential deal with Tesla ahead of its planned IPO. The move could combine rockets, satellites, AI and social media into a single powerhouse while advancing Musk’s vision of space-based data centers.

item.title: Budget 2026: SBI Research details steps for better pension protection in society
item.description: A developed nation needs a developed pension system. As the policymakers have set their sight on the year 2047 to attain the status of a developed nation, it must also work towards a robust pension system for all. SBI Research has put out a few recommendation in that direction.

item.title: Msafe Equipments IPO GMP soars, strong subscription; last day to apply today
item.description: Msafe Equipments SME IPO closes today, January 30, after massive investor interest, subscribing 25.55 times. With a strong Grey Market Premium (GMP) of Rs 26, the IPO projects a potential 21% listing profit on BSE SME. The Rs 66.42 crore issue, priced at Rs 116-123, aims to fund expansion and working capital. Allotment is due February 2.

item.title: News9 Indian Tigers & Tigresses: Girl power dominates Alakhpura trials
item.description: A total of 224 girls participated in the TV9 Network’s News9 Indian Tigers & Tigresses Season 2 in the Alakhpura village in Bhiwani, Haryana.
